Re: Appeal for Claim CLM-558201  
Patient: Theresa Mund  
MRN: 28815  
Date of Service: 2026-04-02  

Dear Claims Reviewer,  

I am writing to formally appeal the denial of claim CLM-558201 for an MRI of the brain (CPT 70553) for my patient, Theresa Mund. The claim was denied on the basis of code CO-50, indicating that the procedure was deemed 'not medically necessary.'  

According to the medical records, Ms. Mund is a 53-year-old female who presented with new focal seizures and an abnormal EEG. The ordering provider, Dr. Aliev, recommended the MRI to exclude any structural causes, following the epilepsy protocol. The clinical documentation supports the necessity of this imaging as it is critical for diagnosing and managing her condition effectively.  

The Statewide Health Plan's medical-necessity criteria clearly state that an MRI is covered for patients with new seizures and abnormal EEG findings, which applies directly to Ms. Mund's case.  

I kindly request that you reconsider the denial of this claim based on the provided evidence. The appeal window is within 60 days, and I am submitting this appeal through the appropriate channels as outlined in your policy.  

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to your prompt response.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Title]  
[Your Practice Name]  
[Your NPI Number]  
[Your Contact Information]
